terms.label: Dataset
terms.comment: Data encoded in a defined structure.

terms.label: Image
terms.comment: A visual representation other than text.

terms.label: Interactive Resource
terms.comment: A resource requiring interaction from the user to be understood, executed, or experienced.

terms.label: Moving Image
terms.comment: A series of visual representations imparting an impression of motion when shown in succession.

terms.label: Physical Object
terms.comment: An inanimate, three-dimensional object or substance.

terms.label: Service
terms.comment: A system that provides one or more functions.

terms.label: Software
terms.comment: A computer program in source or compiled form.

terms.label: Sound
terms.comment: A resource primarily intended to be heard.

terms.label: Text
terms.comment: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading.
